title: Project import reports access and quota failures
description: Use an account with a confirmed Project access or quota failure, with PROJECT_IMPORT_URL and PROJECT_IMPORT_LOGIN set to match the inputs. Supply the observed failure_text. The scenario reads metadata without saving a team or starting work.

gateway-access.intent: The production import API reports an access or quota failure and persists no policy or work.

open-prs.intent: The operator can configure PR sources from the connected dashboard.

wait-panel.intent: Source authoring remains accessible independently of active runs.

open-rules.intent: Team and rule configuration is available to the authorized operator.

open-team.intent: A new team draft can inspect sources before any policy is saved.

choose-account.intent: Project reads use the explicitly selected GitHub account.

enter-url.intent: The saved-view URL identifies the Project scope the operator intends to import.

import.intent: Import requests real provider metadata without saving a broader source.

access-error.intent: Unavailable Project access or quota is explicit and does not appear as an empty successful import.

show-error.intent: The provider failure is readable alongside the unchanged team draft.

capture.intent: The evidence shows the real provider denial and source configuration controls.

close-draft.intent: Discard the unsaved validation draft without modifying existing teams.
